name: nft-lower-priority-chain-drops
description: a chain at negative priority runs before the accepting one
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 accept
nft add chain inet f pre "{ type filter hook output priority -10; policy accept; }"

action.spec: nft add rule inet f pre ip daddr 10.5.5.2 drop
